autoSavePausedTitle: Auto-save paused: file was deleted from disk. Save manually with {{shortcut}}.
divergentTitle: Local differs from disk. Save ({{shortcut}}) to sync, or use File > Revert to discard local changes.
mcpListenerFailedTitle: This window cannot answer AI requests: its MCP request listener failed to start. Restart VMark to try again.
mcpHistoryNoRevisions: No revisions recorded for this document yet.
mcpHistoryUnavailable: The edit history could not be read.
mcpHistoryReasonExternalReload: the file was reloaded from disk
mcpHistoryReasonUncertifiedRange: an edit that could not be traced
mcpHistoryReasonUnclosedEpoch: an editing session that did not close
mcpHistoryReasonParentMismatch: the history and the document disagree
mcpHistoryStatusFailed: The edit history is unavailable — changes are not being recorded.
mcpHistoryStatusReadOnly: The edit history is read-only — new changes are not being recorded.
mcpHistoryStatusDegraded: The edit history is behind — some records are queued and not yet on disk.
mcpHistoryStatusLiveUpdatesFailed: Live updates from other windows are unavailable — the history refreshes every few seconds instead.
mcpHistoryStatusDocQueued: Changes to this document are queued and not yet recorded.
mcpHistoryStatusRefused: The last save was not recorded in the history ({{code}}).
mcpHistoryStatusTimeout: The last save was not recorded: the history did not answer in time.
mcpHistoryStatusBlocked: Changes whose automatic revert is blocked: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusFailedBecause: The edit history is unavailable — changes are not being recorded ({{detail}}).
mcpHistoryStatusStartupProblem: Part of the edit history's startup failed: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryStatusIdentityDisabled: History recording is off because the document identity index could not be used: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryStatusIdentityUnbound: History recording is suspended because document identity could not be updated.
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionNearCap: Edit history storage limits nearly reached: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionPinnedOverCap: Edit history storage limits exceeded by history that must be kept: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionBlobError: Edit history cleanup could not remove unused data: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionFailed: Edit history cleanup could not run: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryEarlierHint: Kept from before the edit history, for every document and window.
mcpHistoryEarlierFallback: Could not open {{path}} — restored into a new document
mcpHistoryRestoreFailed: Could not restore: the document was edited, or the history is unavailable
mcpHistoryRestoreAppliedWithError: Restored the version, but the editor reported an error — check the document
mcpHistoryRestoreRecoveryRequired: Could not confirm the restore — this document stays locked for agent edits until VMark restarts
mcpHistoryClearedTextPending: Cleared all checkpoint history. Their text stays on disk until the next compaction
mcpHistoryClearFailed: Could not clear the checkpoint history: the history is unavailable
mcpHistoryUncommittedHint: Applied to the document, but the history could not record them.
mcpHistoryUncommittedRestore: Restore the text this unrecorded write found
mcpHistoryUncommittedRestored: Restored the text from before the unrecorded write
mcpHistoryUncommittedFailed: Could not change the unrecorded write: the document was edited or the history is busy
yamlWysiwygBlocked: WYSIWYG mode would corrupt YAML indentation. Edit YAML in source mode.
